exams.name: Examination conducted by or acceptable to the board
exams.notes: If an applicant fails to pass any step of the examination on two separate occasions, the applicant may be required to be interviewed, evaluated, or examined by the board.
exams.jurisdiction: national or state (acceptable to the board)
exams.quote: Each applicant must pass an examination conducted by or acceptable to the board that shall thoroughly test the applicant's fitness to practice medicine. If an applicant fails to pass any step of the examination on two (2) separate occasions, the applicant may be required to be interviewed, evaluated, or examined by the board.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) 1 and 2
exams.notes: Required for international physicians seeking a provisional license. USMLE 3 required at the conclusion of the three-year provisional period to apply for full licensure.
exams.quote: An international physician seeking a provisional license pursuant to this section must possess a passing score on the United States medical licensing examination (USMLE) 1 and 2. If an applicant fails to pass either step of the examination on two (2) separate occasions, the applicant may be required to be interviewed, evaluated, or examined by the board.

interval_years.quote: such licenses shall be issued for a period of no more than five (5) years, the exact period to be fixed by the board

required.quote: Physicians shall comply with all continuing professional development or continuing medical education requirements for renewal of a license issued by a member state.

available.quote: Any person seeking to be licensed to practice medicine as a physician in this state who is licensed to practice medicine in another state must successfully complete the following requirements before a license to practice medicine will be issued

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid, unrevoked, unsuspended license in another US state, territory, district, or Canada; demonstrate requisite qualifications for Idaho standard of care; submit a fingerprint-based criminal history check; and have no disciplinary actions. An applicant with any disciplinary action is not eligible.
requirements.quote: proof that the applicant holds a valid, unrevoked, unsuspended license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in a state, territory or district of the United States or Canada and the applicant demonstrates that he possesses the requisite qualifications to provide the same standard of health care as provided by licensed physicians in this state

exists.quote: "Board" means the state board of medicine.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue licenses to practice medicine and osteopathic medicine to persons who have qualified therefor in accordance with the provisions of this act.

title_protection.quote: it is unlawful for any person to assume or use the title or designation "medical doctor," "medical physician," "osteopathic doctor," "osteopathic physician," "physician assistant," "M.D.," "D.O.," or "P.A.," or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device to indicate to the public that such person is licensed to practice medicine pursuant to this chapter unless such person is so licensed

scope_protection.quote: it shall constitute a felony for any person to practice medicine in this state without a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of, pleading guilty to, or found guilty of a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of a felony, pleading guilty to a felony, or the finding of guilt by a jury or court of commission of a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using false, fraudulent, or forged statements or documents in connection with licensing requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using false, fraudulent or forged statements or documents, diplomas or credentials in connection with any licensing or other requirements of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name in this or any other state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name in this or any other state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of medicine in an unethical or unprofessional manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the practice of medicine in any unethical or unprofessional manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or abetting an unauthorized person to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding or abetting any person to practice medicine who is not authorized to practice medicine as provided in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or procuring an unlawful abortion or aiding in same
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or procuring an unlawful abortion or aiding or abetting the performing or procuring of an unlawful abortion.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing health care which fails to meet the standard of health care provided by other qualified physicians in the same or similar communities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing health care which fails to meet the standard of health care provided by other qualified physicians or physician assistants in the same community or similar communities, taking into account his training, experience and the degree of expertise to which he holds himself out to the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees or agreeing to split fees in exchange for referral
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees or gifts or agreeing to split or divide fees or gifts received for professional services with any person, institution or corporation in exchange for referral.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving rebates, directly or indirectly
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving or receiving or aiding or abetting the giving or receiving of rebates, either directly or indirectly.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to obtain or renew, or revocation/suspension of, a medical license by another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to obtain or renew a license to practice medicine, or revocation, suspension, or other discipline of a license to practice medicine by any other state, territory, district of the United States or Canada, unless it can be shown that such action was not related to the competence of the person to practice medicine or to any conduct designated herein.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or furnishing narcotic or hallucinogenic drugs to addicted persons solely to maintain their addictions without treating the primary condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or furnishing narcotic or hallucinogenic drugs to addicted persons to maintain their addictions and level of usage without attempting to treat the primary condition requiring the use of narcotics.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or furnishing narcotic, hypnotic, hallucinogenic, stimulating, or dangerous drugs for other than treatment of disease, injury, or medical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or furnishing narcotic, hypnotic, hallucinogenic, stimulating or dangerous drugs for other than treatment of any disease, injury or medical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to safeguard the confidentiality of medical records or other medical information pertaining to identifiable patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to safeguard the confidentiality of medical records or other medical information pertaining to identifiable patients, except as required or authorized by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly promoting the sale of drugs, devices, or goods to a patient that are unnecessary and not medically indicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly promoting the sale of drugs, devices, appliances or goods to a patient that are unnecessary and not medically indicated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully representing that a manifestly incurable condition can be permanently cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and intentionally representing that a manifestly incurable disease or injury or other manifestly incurable condition can be permanently cured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to supervise the activities of interns, residents, nurse practitioners, certified nurse-midwives, clinical nurse specialists, or physician assistants
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to supervise the activities of interns, residents, nurse practitioners, certified nurse-midwives, clinical nurse specialists, or physician assistants.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine when the license is suspended, revoked, or inactive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine when a license pursuant to this chapter is suspended, revoked or inactive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine in violation of a voluntary restriction or terms of probation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine in violation of a voluntary restriction or terms of probation pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to divulge to the board the means, method, device, or instrumentality used in treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to divulge to the board upon demand the means, method, device or instrumentality used in the treatment of a disease, injury, ailment, or infirmity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act constituting a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any act constituting a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that constitutes abuse or exploitation of a patient arising out of the trust and confidence placed in the physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct which constitutes an abuse or exploitation of a patient arising out of the trust and confidence placed in the physician by the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading guilty to driving under the influence or other drug or alcohol related criminal charges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of or pleading guilty to driving under the influence of alcohol, drugs or other intoxicating substances or being convicted of or pleading guilty to other drug or alcohol related criminal charges.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with a board order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with a board order entered by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the requirements of the abortion complications reporting act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements of the abortion complications reporting act, chapter 95, title 39, Idaho Code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a pattern of unprofessional or disruptive behavior in a health care setting that interferes with patient care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a pattern of unprofessional or disruptive behavior or interaction in a health care setting that interferes with patient care or could reasonably be expected to adversely impact the quality of care rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interfering with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation or threats
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interfering with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation of facts or by use of threats of harassment against any patient, member of a board or committee on professional discipline, board staff, hearing officer, or witness in an attempt to influence the outcome of a disciplinary proceeding, investigation, or other legal action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to an unlicensed or unqualified person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to: (a) An unlicensed person when the licensee knows or has reason to know that such person is not qualified by training, experience, or license to carry them out; or (b) A person licensed by this state to engage in activities which may involve the practice of medicine when the delegating licensee knows or has reason to know that the delegated activities are outside the licensed person's scope of practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report the charge or conviction of a felony to the board within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report the charge or conviction of a felony to the board within thirty (30) days of the charge.

citations.kind: limited license for bridge year physicians

definition_quote.value: The investigation, diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of or prescription for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality that involves the application of principles or techniques of medical science
definition_quote.quote: The investigation, diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of or prescription for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality that involves the application of principles or techniques of medical science

methods_authorized.quote: The investigation, diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of or prescription for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality that involves the application of principles or techniques of medical science

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs including controlled substances within the scope of licensed practice; prescriptions via virtual care may not include controlled substances unless compliant with 21 U.S.C.
drug_authority.quote: the prescription drug shall not be a controlled substance unless prescribed in compliance with 21 U.S.C.

license_status_types.quote: The board may renew on an inactive basis, the license of a physician or physician assistant who is not practicing medicine in this state.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International physicians must graduate from an international medical program evaluated and certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG), complete post-graduate training, practice for 3 years or complete 500 hours supervised clinical experience in the US, practice within the last 5 years (or obtain a waiver), demonstrate English fluency, and obtain a 3-year provisional license with a sponsoring entity employing a supervising Idaho-licensed board-certified physician. USMLE 1 and 2 required for provisional license; USMLE 3 required for full licensure.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: International physician" means any individual who: (a) Was not a legal resident of the United States or Canada when they attended and matriculated from an international medical program

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: The board shall grant a three (3) year provisional license to international physicians

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A provider with an established provider-patient relationship may issue prescription drug orders via virtual care within scope of license; controlled substances may not be prescribed via virtual care unless compliant with 21 U.S.C. Treatment based solely on a static online questionnaire does not constitute an acceptable standard of care.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A provider with an established provider-patient relationship, including a relationship established pursuant to section 54-5705, Idaho Code, may issue prescription drug orders and prescription medical device orders via virtual care within the scope of the provider's license and according to any applicable state and federal laws, rules, and regulations, including the Idaho community standard of care. However, the prescription drug shall not be a controlled substance unless prescribed in compliance with 21 U.S.C.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Prior to delivering health care services via virtual care, a provider must obtain a license from the applicable licensing board

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The interstate medical licensure compact is hereby enacted into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining therein

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The degree and nature of collaboration shall be determined by the facility or practice in which the physician assistant works and shall be set forth in facility bylaws or procedures for facilities that have credentialing and privileging systems or in a written collaborative practice agreement for all other facilities and practices.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may have prescriptive authority as part of their licensed practice; scope determined by board rules and collaborative practice agreement.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant may practice at a licensed health care facility, a facility with a credentialing and privileging system, a physician-owned facility or practice, or another facility or practice allowed by this chapter.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may enter into agreements with peer assistance entities to undertake those functions and responsibilities specified in the agreements which assist the board in performing its duties, implementing disciplinary actions or sanctions, and in addressing potential or confirmed problems of chemical dependency and/or impairment, psychological impairment, and mental or physical impairment affecting board licentiates.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Every physician and physician assistant who accepts the privilege of being licensed under this chapter gives consent to: (a) Submitting at the licensee's own expense to an immediate mental or physical examination when directed in writing by the board to do so
